name: Question 3
problem:
$$
{y}^{″}+2y=f(x),\,y(0)=0,\,{y}^{′}(0)=3
$$

Consider the initial value problem above, where $f(x)$ is an odd, $2\pi $-periodic function. Select the missing part in the solution of the IVP, where the second infinite sum on the right-hand side below represents a particular solution of the differential equation.

$$
y(x)∼{{field-1}}+{\sum }_{n=1}^{\infty }{b}_{n}\operatorname{sin}⁡(nx)
$$
